name: Cal.com
label: Cal.com — Cal.com API v2
description: Cal.com via the official Cal.com API v2. Base https://api.cal.com/v2. Docs: https://cal.com/docs/api-reference/v2/introduction. Every HTTP call sends header cal-api-version. Spec default is 2024-08-13 (https://cal.com/docs/api-reference/v2/v1-v2-differences); current OpenAPI requires 2026-02-25 on booking create/get/reschedule/cancel, 2026-05-01 on list-bookings, and 2024-06-14 on event-types (op-level extraHeaders). API v1 shut down 2026-04-08. Self-host uses a different host; OfficialApiNode is pinned to api.cal.com. Inbound booking events (created/cancelled/rescheduled) are BPMN message events only — there is no HTTP listen operation on this node. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments use type file (ref-id).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Cal.com operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. For create-booking use eventTypeId OR (eventTypeSlug + username/teamSlug) per Cal.com v2; attendee is an object {name, timeZone, email?, …}, not a JSON string. Webhook-style booking events use BPMN message events only — there is no HTTP listen operation. Example: {"operation":"create-booking"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT HTTP values: create-booking | get-booking | list-bookings | reschedule-booking | cancel-booking | list-event-types | get-event-type. Inbound booking webhooks are BPMN message events only (not an operation here). Example: create-booking.

schema.label: uid
schema.description: Booking uid. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Event type id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: eventTypeId
schema.description: Event type id for create-booking. Required unless eventTypeSlug + username (or + teamSlug) is used. Omit when unused.

schema.label: eventTypeSlug
schema.description: Event type slug for create-booking (with username or teamSlug) when eventTypeId is omitted. Cal.com v2.

schema.label: username
schema.description: Host username for create-booking when using eventTypeSlug (personal event). Optional organizationSlug when applicable.

schema.label: teamSlug
schema.description: Team slug for create-booking when using eventTypeSlug (team event). Optional organizationSlug when applicable.

schema.label: organizationSlug
schema.description: Organization slug for create-booking when hosts are inside an org (optional).

schema.label: usernames
schema.description: Dynamic group booking: 2–20 host usernames (Cal.com). Cannot combine with eventTypeId or eventTypeSlug/username.

schema.label: guests
schema.description: Optional guest emails for create-booking (array of strings).

schema.label: lengthInMinutes
schema.description: Optional duration for dynamic group bookings (15, 30, 45, 60, or 90).

schema.label: start
schema.description: ISO 8601 start time (UTC) for create-booking and reschedule-booking.

schema.label: attendee
schema.description: Attendee object for create-booking: name, timeZone (required per API), email, phoneNumber, language. Do not pass a JSON string — use a nested object so the wire body stays an object.

schema.label: bookingFieldsResponses
schema.description: Custom booking field responses (slug → value) for create-booking.

schema.label: leadEnrichmentOptOut
schema.description: Lead enrichment opt-out for create-booking when the event type uses that workflow.

schema.label: metadata
schema.description: Optional metadata object for create-booking.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Query-string parameter `status` for operation: list-bookings.

schema.label: take
schema.description: Query-string parameter `take` for operation: list-bookings.

schema.label: skip
schema.description: Query-string parameter `skip` for operation: list-bookings.

schema.label: cancellationReason
schema.description: Request-body parameter `cancellationReason` for operation: cancel-booking.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: create-booking, get-booking, list-bookings, reschedule-booking, cancel-booking, list-event-types, get-event-type. Booking webhooks use BPMN message events, not a listen operation.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Cal.com API key. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
